evidence.text: Direct inspection of the scan confirms the 問(问) wèn headword and its paragraph: the entry says 形聲字，从口，門聲; gives “本义是问讯、询问”; says the oracle-bone form had appeared but its meaning was unclear; notes bronze and Warring States seal uses as a personal name; and lists extensions from inquiry including 问难、过问、审问、责问、访问、慰问、打听, plus a 通闻 use. evidence.text: The entry explicitly repeats the received 說文 analysis “訊也。从口，門聲,” identifies 口 and 門 in that analysis, and gives wèn. It lists ask, investigate/pursue, interrogate, gift, visit, letter/news and other uses; this is a dictionary inventory, not a dated semantic sequence.

evidence.source: 蘇影, Fudan University Center for Research on Excavated Texts and Paleography
evidence.field: Article discussion of oracle-bone identification, pre-Qin writings and Qin-slip uses
evidence.text: The article reports that two Shang forms composed of 門 and 口 were traditionally catalogued as 問, but argues their use as the word 問 is not found in the Western Zhou bronze and Chu-slip evidence it surveys. It reports 聞/昏 graphs used to write the word in bronze and Chu materials, and identifies late Warring States Qin slips as the earliest clear evidence in its survey for the 問 graph meaning ask/inquire. It tentatively proposes the Shang forms may be expanded forms of 啟 and says their inscriptional meaning is unclear. This is an attributed argument, not a settled identification or independently checked dating of the cited slips.
evidence.title: 蘇影：甲骨文“問”字釋讀獻疑

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
evidence.field: 問 entry, 形義通解 and sense examples
evidence.text: The entry distinguishes the received Small Seal analysis 从口、門聲 from earlier Shang and Zhou graphs described as 門+口 or two 口 elements; it cautions that the earlier graphs and Small Seal 問 may not represent the same word and that the oracle-bone contexts are fragmentary and unclear. It reports Qin-slip examples using 問 for questioning and separately reports loan-writing with 聞/昏. Its received-word entry glosses 問 as interrogation/inquiry, extending to asking and doubt.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 問

evidence.text: The contemporary dictionary gives the ordinary sense “向人請教疑難” with examples including 詢問 and 發問, and lists other senses separately. It does not mark the ask sense obsolete or restrict it to a historical quotation; this supports current usage.

The received Shuowen analysis supports the semantic 口 and phonetic 門 roles for traditional 問, but no inspected same-system historical reconstruction table established the sound correspondence. The supplied local Unihan extract records current readings 口 kǒu, 問 wèn, 門 mén and 门 mén at rows 120, 146, 486 and 488; official Unicode character-reading pages failed, so do not cite those local rows as externally inspected character pages.

The Baxter–Sagart comparison included in the existing article could not be verified against an accessible external table in this invocation, and the referenced sources/baxter-sagart/baxtersagart.tsv is absent from this checkout. Reassess or remove that sound array and the associated unsupported historical comparison claims; this is a citation/access gap, not evidence that the phonetic role is false.

The spoken-word derivation from 聞 plus exoactive *-s remains unverified against the underlying cited scholarly work. It must remain distinctly attributed and qualified; graph loan-writing evidence does not prove that derivation.

No independently dated semantic pathway was established from ask/inquire to the book’s listed senses. Current dictionary evidence confirms ask/inquire use; dictionary gloss lists do not date the extensions.
The precise dates of the Qin-slip contexts are reported by scholarly references and were not independently verified against primary editions or excavation documentation in this investigation.
